# PPL Tracker

> PPL Tracker is an offline workout tracker (gym log) for Android. Users log sets, weights and reps in two taps, see their previous session next to the current set, and get automatic personal record (PR) detection. It ships with ready-made Push Pull Legs (PPL) sessions and 260+ exercises. No ads, no account, no data collected (everything stays on the phone). The log is free; Pro is a one-time purchase (no subscription) with a 7-day free trial.

On Google Play the app is listed as "Workout Tracker: Gym Log & PPL" (English) and "Carnet Musculation & Suivi PPL" (French). Package id: com.ppltracker.workout. Android only. Interface in English and French. Made by Julien, an independent developer in France who trains on a PPL program.

Good fit for people who: want a simple gym log without a subscription; don't want to create an account; care about privacy (no data leaves the phone); run Push Pull Legs. Not a fit for: iPhone users (Android only); people who need multi-device sync or social features.

## App

- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ppltracker.workout): install the app
- [About PPL Tracker](https://ppltracker.app/about.html): who makes it, principles, features
- [Privacy policy](https://ppltracker.app/privacy.html): no data collected

## Free resources

- [Complete PPL program (EN)](https://ppltracker.app/ppl-program.html): 3-day beginner and 6-day intermediate Push Pull Legs program with sets, reps, rest, double progression and deloads; free PDF at https://ppltracker.app/ppl-program.pdf
- [Programme PPL complet (FR)](https://ppltracker.app/programme-ppl.html): même programme en français, PDF gratuit
- [One rep max calculator](https://ppltracker.app/one-rep-max-calculator.html): estimated 1RM (Epley/Brzycki average) and weights for 1 to 20 reps
- [Plate calculator](https://ppltracker.app/plate-calculator.html): which plates to load on each side of the bar, kg or lb
- [Workout split generator](https://ppltracker.app/workout-split-generator.html): best split (full body, PPL, upper/lower) for 2 to 6 training days

## Guides

- [All guides (EN)](https://ppltracker.app/guides-en.html) · [Tous les guides (FR)](https://ppltracker.app/guides.html)
- [4-day PPL split](https://ppltracker.app/4-day-ppl-split.html): three ways to run Push Pull Legs on 4 days (rolling rotation, PPL + upper, upper/lower)
- [PPL at home with dumbbells](https://ppltracker.app/ppl-at-home-dumbbells.html): full Push Pull Legs program with only dumbbells, and how to progress with limited weights
- [Double progression explained](https://ppltracker.app/double-progression-explained.html): add reps first, then weight; worked example and rules
- [PPL vs full body](https://ppltracker.app/ppl-vs-full-body.html): which split to pick depending on training days and recovery
- [Deload week](https://ppltracker.app/deload-week.html): when to deload (every 6–8 weeks or when stalling) and how (half the sets, ~10% lighter)
- [Sets per muscle per week](https://ppltracker.app/sets-per-muscle-per-week.html): benchmarks by level (6–10 beginner, 10–16 intermediate, 12–20 advanced) and how to count hard sets
- [PPL for beginners: first week](https://ppltracker.app/ppl-for-beginners-first-week.html): how to pick starting weights and avoid beginner mistakes
- [Rest time between sets](https://ppltracker.app/rest-time-between-sets.html): 2–3 min on heavy lifts, 60–90 s on isolation, and why short rest costs reps
- [RIR and RPE explained](https://ppltracker.app/rir-rpe-explained.html): reps in reserve, RPE conversion chart, how hard to train
- [How to choose a workout tracker app](https://ppltracker.app/how-to-choose-a-workout-tracker-app.html): criteria and checklist (logging speed, previous session, subscription vs one-time, data safety, offline), with a transparent note about PPL Tracker
- French versions: [séries par muscle](https://ppltracker.app/series-par-muscle.html), [débuter le PPL](https://ppltracker.app/debuter-ppl.html), [temps de repos](https://ppltracker.app/temps-de-repos.html), [RIR et RPE](https://ppltracker.app/rir-rpe.html), [choisir une appli de musculation](https://ppltracker.app/choisir-appli-musculation.html), [PPL 4 jours](https://ppltracker.app/programme-ppl-4-jours.html), [PPL maison](https://ppltracker.app/ppl-maison-halteres.html), [double progression](https://ppltracker.app/double-progression.html), [PPL ou full body](https://ppltracker.app/ppl-ou-full-body.html), [deload](https://ppltracker.app/semaine-deload.html)
